wiki.title: Raven
wiki.text:
Raven is a harpy NPC boss featured as the primary antagonist in the Hero Rises questline. Disguised as the Bixie Queen, she attempted to take over Wugachug using gloamwater sarsaparilla. When inside the party tent, at the end of the Chug-a-Mug Challenge battle, she will appear outside the tent to tells the contestants to stop fighting. After the player come to fight Raven in Highroad Junction, she fails and got defeated by the player.

Battle
In the old tutorial area, in Highroad Junction as a world boss. When Raven is there, massive logs will appear and she will fly between them. To get up, you must find some green tornadoes and jump where they are. This will rocket you up and you can land on them. The teleport is quite frequent so be fast. Once defeated, Raven drops Raven's Treasure Chest, bixies will appear and the logs will not be there.

Gallery

Trivia
Raven was introduced in the update of August 13th, 2013.
Raven is currently the only known harpy in Sacred Grove, although Chugzy mentions that harpies are from Lavender Coast, thus implying that there are more of her kind.
Two world bosses, Raven and Nekark were supposed to have Level 20 Awakened fights similar to Necronomicus, but they were never completed before the game shut down.
